Intent: (1) Cards/thumbnails stay button-free; left-click opens details, right-click opens actions, Shift+F10 and the menu key also open actions. (2) Card clicks must keep working where the experimental `layoutsubtree` canvas swallows hit-testing: probe first, fall back to the DOM/CSS liquid glass. (3) Details open and close as ONE motion: item, patterned background and right panel move together both ways (single `--item-progress` var animated by GSAP), reduced motion respected. Out of scope: the experimental sidebar, backend, Linux/updater, restyling.
Checks: `bun run check:changed` passes on this head; 7 new tests pass; the author verified in the real Windows Electron app with real mouse events (left/right-click, menu key, Shift+F10, mid-flight progress sampling). Reduced motion and touch were not driven at runtime.

Find bugs, broken callers, mismatch with intent. Skip style unless it hides a bug. Hold to the smallest change: flag code, tests or guards the intent does not need. Other paths, rare cases, small perf and extra compat are nits. Also watch AGENTS.md rules: no continuously repainting animation, no per-frame work outside the open/close flight, comments only where needed.

content.text:
VERDICT: CHANGES

S1 [should] src/features/item-view/ItemView.tsx:437 Reduced motion is not respected when switching items. The settled branch of the item-switch effect starts a close flight and then an open flight with no `prefersReducedMotion()` check, unlike the mount path (:271), `requestClose` (:219) and archive (:238). A reduced-motion user who picks an item from the Similar tab still gets the full flight. This is pre-existing (same code at 0e40de9), but the PR claims reduced motion is respected for this motion. Fix: when `prefersReducedMotion()`, skip both legs and swap the item in place, as the mount path does (`setDestination(frameRect())` plus a layer opacity fade).

S2 [should] src/features/item-view/ItemStageMedia.tsx:16 The art box is sized by `group-data-flying/item:size-full`, a class switch, not by `--item-progress`. So the item snaps at both ends of every flight. At the end of an open flight it goes from the stage content box (roughly 984x764 on a 1400x900 window) to the rest `min(100%,720px) x min(100%,520px)`, and the reverse happens at close start. The changelog line "the item ... move[s] together instead of ... settling separately" is not met for the item. This is pre-existing, but the single-var design is the natural place to fix it. Fix: derive the art box size from `--item-progress` (for example a `calc` that blends from 100% to the rest cap), or drop the data-flying size switch. Otherwise correct the changelog claim. Check it in the app at a 1400px window.

S3 [nit] src/features/item-view/ItemView.tsx:597 During a flight the stage border is now always visible, and its radius is fixed at the frame radius. The base used `border-transparent` and `rounded-[inherit]` while flying, so a 1px outline now shows on the growing card edge. Fix: keep the border transparent until progress reaches 1, or accept it after a before/after look.

S4 [nit] src/components/canvasInput.ts:17 `hit === content ||` is redundant, and `hit !== null &&` is too, because `content.contains(null)` is false. Fix: `return content.contains(document.elementFromPoint(1, 1));`.

S5 [nit] src/features/item-view/ItemView.tsx:220 `requestClose` during an open flight with no card rect (or reduced motion turned on mid-flight) calls `setFlight(null)` and leaves `--item-progress` at its mid value. `placedStyle` then snaps the view to the frame at that partial progress for the 150 ms layer fade. Rare. Fix: `gsap.set(dialog, { "--item-progress": 1 })` before `setFlight(null)`.

Checked and fine: the probe is cached, returns null on failure, and fails safe. The `getProperty` retarget at ItemView.tsx:430 is sound, since GSAP 3.15 reads CSS variables via `getComputedStyle`. Card keydown and the menu anchoring match the intent, and the 7 tests cover them.
